{"metadata":{"description":"DSH plugin: sub-agent matrix swarm — routes heterogeneous tasks to the most suitable model (OpenRouter-like + cfgpu.com/llm/square), dispatches each via in-process subagents. 32/32 benchmark green.","id":"gh:1335322369","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-swarm-router","slug":"r600a-code/dsh-swarm-router","topics":["cfgpu","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","llm-routing","subagent","swarm"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH plugin: sub-agent matrix swarm — routes heterogeneous tasks to the most suitable model (OpenRout"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"er-like + cfgpu.com/llm/square), dispatches each via in-process subagents. 32/32 benchmark green."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-swarm-router"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness **bundle** that turns a batch of heterogeneous tasks into a **sub-agent matrix sw"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"arm**: it routes each task to the most suitable model from an OpenRouter-like gateway plus the `cfgp"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"u.com/llm/square` catalog, then dispatches each assignment in parallel as a real in-process subagent"},{"id":"p4s4","text":" (or a direct `ctx.llm` call) pinned to that model — quick tasks land on fast/cheap models, hard tas"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"ks on strong reasoning models. A formal design write-up lives in `docs/PAPER.md`."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **子智能体矩阵蜂群**：任务是行、候选模型是列，路由器为每一行选中一格，再通过 DSH 的 `ctx.subagents` 把每格变成一个绑定到所选模型的子智能体并行下放，按任务难度匹配模型、省"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"时提效。论文见 `docs/PAPER.zh.md`。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## The four contributions"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| | Contribution | What |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| ① | **Model aggregation registry + PR flow** | `models/registry.json` is the canonical catalog; `s"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"cripts/validate-registry.mjs` enforces structure (CI-ready); `CONTRIBUTING.md` documents the add-a-m"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"odel PR flow. |
| ② | **Plugin extension point** | `ctx.provide('swarmRouter', api)` — other plugins"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" `inject: ['swarmRouter']` to register runtime models, custom task kinds, subscribe to feedback, rea"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"d rankings/usage. |
| ③ | **Real-task feedback + ranking** | `swarm_feedback` records `{correct, qua"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"lity 1-5}`, persisted to `rankings.json`; `swarm_ranking` shows per-model/per-kind success rate & qu"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ality; proven models are **boosted** in routing, failing ones **demoted**. |
| ④ | **Token-consumpti"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"on statistics (cfgpu highlighted)** | `direct` mode captures exact per-call `prompt/completion/total"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"` from `ctx.llm.stream`; `subagent` mode captures via a **global `llm/stream` listener attributed by"},{"id":"p8s10","text":" `sessionId`**; persisted to `usage.json`; `swarm_stats` shows totals/byProvider/byModel/byKind + `c"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"ersisted to `usage.json`; `swarm_stats` shows totals/byProvider/byModel/byKind + `cfgpuHighlight`. |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Tool | Mode | Calls models? |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| `swarm_route_preview` | — | No (pure routing plan) |
| `swarm_dispatch` | `subagent` (default) \| "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"`direct` | Yes (parallel) |
| `swarm_models` | — | No (list registry) |
| `swarm_feedback` | — | No "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"(records an outcome) |
| `swarm_ranking` | — | No (reads accumulated feedback) |
| `swarm_stats` | —"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" | No (reads accumulated usage) |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## The router rules (how a task becomes a model)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"A task is `{ id, kind, prompt, maxTokens? }` where `kind ∈ {reasoning, coding, longcontext, fast, ge"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"neral}`. The router is **pure and O(1) per task** — it spends *zero* model-time deciding *which* mod"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"el; the saving goes into parallel dispatch."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**Step 1 — infer the kind.** An explicit `kind` wins; otherwise the first truthy hint among `{reason"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ing, coding, longContext, fast}` is used, defaulting to `general`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**Step 2 — capability gate (hard filter).** Each kind requires a capability tag; a model lacking it "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"scores `-∞` and is dropped:
- `reasoning` requires `reasoning`; `coding` requires `coding`; `longcon"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"text` requires `longContext`; `fast`/`general` require nothing."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**Step 3 — effort-matched weighted score.** For the surviving models, a kind-specific linear score i"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"s computed from the catalog's 1–10 ranks (`strength`, `speed`, `cost`) and capacities (`contextWindo"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"he catalog's 1–10 ranks (`strength`, `speed`, `cost`) and capacities (`contextWindow`, `maxTokens`):"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| kind | weight vector |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| `reasoning` | `reasoning×3 + strength×2 + coding×0.3 + contextWindow×0.000004` |
| `coding` | `cod"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ing×3 + strength×2.5 + longContext×0.3` |
| `longcontext` | `contextWindow×0.00002 + strength×0.5 + "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"coding×0.3` |
| `fast` | `speed×3 + cost×1.5 + strength×0.3` |
| `general` | `strength×2 + speed×0.6"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" + cost×0.3 + coding×0.3` |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**Step 4 — penalties (the effort-matching core).**
- `kind ≠ fast` and `model.fast` → **−2.0** (a fa"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"st/cheap tier is under-powered for quality work).
- `kind = general` and `model.reasoning` → **−2.0*"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"* (a reasoning flagship is *overkill* — slower, pricier — for general work).
- `kind = coding` and `"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"model.reasoning` → **−0.5** (reasoning helps code but is not required; slight demotion vs. a pure co"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"ding-strong peer).
- `model.unstable` → **−4** (route was flaky during catalog capture).
- `model.av"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"ailable = false` → **−1000** (e.g. OpenRouter without a key).
- **Ranking feedback boost** (when `us"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"eRankings: true`): `successRate ≥ 0.9` over ≥ 3 trials → **+1.5**; `successRate ≤ 0.4` → **−3.0**. R"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"eal outcomes override the static catalog."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Why the design"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Matrix, not a single pipeline.** A diverse batch fans out across several models — the `distinctM"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"odels` summary is the signal that routing is *doing something* rather than collapsing to one model.
"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"- **Distinct LLM routes (`cfgpu-swarm`, `openrouter`), not the machine's `cfgpu`.** `llm-pi-ai` merg"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"es provider routes by key (composition base ∪ settings); distinct keys union without clash, so the s"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"warm's catalog never disturbs the orchestrator's own model. A patch replaces a row's whole `config`,"},{"id":"p22s6","text":" so we add routes rather than editing settings.
- **Pure router, then dispatch.** Separating "decide"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"" from "do" makes routing free, testable, and preview-able (`swarm_route_preview`), and lets dispatc"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"h (`direct` vs `subagent`) be chosen per task.
- **`direct` mode for token truth.** A one-shot `ctx."},{"id":"p22s9","text":"llm.stream` reads the `usage` chunk directly — exact per-call accounting including cfgpu's `reasonin"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"g_tokens` (when the adapter emits it). `subagent` mode is for tasks needing the agent loop; its usag"},{"id":"p22s11","text":"e is captured via a global `llm/stream` listener attributed by `sessionId == child run.id` (the only"},{"id":"p22s12","text":" mechanism that catches child calls without scope filtering — confirmed by source research).
- **Fee"},{"id":"p22s13","text":"dback closes the loop.** Static catalog ranks are author guesses; real task outcomes, persisted and "},{"id":"p22s14","text":"folded into a boost, let a model that *looks* strong but fails in practice get demoted, and a sleepe"},{"id":"p22s15","text":"oost, let a model that *looks* strong but fails in practice get demoted, and a sleeper get promoted."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Install & run"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The cfgpu route needs `CFGPU_API_KEY` in `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` (or env). The OpenRouter rout"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"e needs `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`; without it the router reports it unavailable and never dispatches to i"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"t, so the profile still boots."}],"truncated":true}
